summary.verdict_desc:
**一句话**：本期红黄绿计数与两轴分数与上期完全一致（7 红 / 9 黄 / 9 绿、风险温度 28.0%、成熟度 60.0 / 临近度 36.7），但这份「不变」是两笔方向相反的重大迁移互相抵消的结果——Fed 路径由「维持」翻转为「隐含加息」而转红，市场广度则因上期那个存疑的 33% 被证实为误读、修正回 54% 而退回黄灯。

**修正**：先把上期最重的一格纠正过来。上期把 breadth_50d 由绿直接打到红（8/21 约 33%），并在当时按纪律注明「四个实时源全部 egress 受限，33% 仅由单一二手源支撑，下期须优先复核；若证实为误读，判读会退回上期格局」。本期复核证实确为误读：8/24-8/28 当周，标普成分股在自身 50 日线上方的比例约 54%（较 8 月中的 70% 回落），200 日线上方仍逾 70%。方向没有错——全周仅 42% 个股上涨、11 个板块只有 3 个收高，而指数仍涨 0.49%，头部与中位数的裂口真实存在——但量级不是腰斩到 33%，不构成 2000 年 2 月那种「指数新高、多数个股跌破均线」的断裂。这一格记为数据修正而非真实好转，已写入 raw_history 的更正条目。

**政策面**：本期唯一的真实恶化来自 Fed。8/28 Warsh 在 Jackson Hole 重申 2% PCE 目标、直言控通胀「仍有工作要做」，市场读为明确鹰派：2 年期收益率单日跳升逾 12bp 至 4.356%、10 年期升逾 5bp 至 4.726%，CME 隐含 9/16 加息概率由讲话前约 35% 跳到 57-60%，模态结果第一次由「维持」翻成「加息」，按 tighten_bad 口径转红（上一次红灯是 6 月底至 7 月中）。要留意口径滞后：本期 HY 利差 263bps 反而较上期 275bps 收窄 12bp，但 FRED 观测日是 8/27、仍在讲话之前，信用面对这次鹰派转向的定价要到下期才看得见——这一格的绿灯目前是「截至讲话前」的绿灯。

**反向证据**：本期反向证据是全年最硬的一批，且集中来自 8/26 的 Nvidia 财报。营收 $962 亿（环比 +18%、同比 +106%）、数据中心 $890 亿、下季指引 $1080 亿，并罕见给出 FY28 营收 +70% 的年度展望（一致预期约 44%），股价 8/27 涨 8.7%；CFO Kress 把前五大 hyperscaler 的 capex 路径由 2026 年 $8000 亿指向 2027 年 $1.3 万亿，在手订单逾 $2 万亿，AWS 承诺采购 200 万颗 GPU。底层用量同向：OpenRouter 官方 API 近 30 日 360.0 万亿 tokens、环比 +50.0%（上期 302.9T / +32.1%），为本口径启用以来最快的一期。需求端与算力端本期没有任何裂纹，裂纹全在资金成本一侧——本周被惩罚的是 Broadcom（约 $3700 亿 AI 债务敞口疑问，单日 -6%）与 neocloud（Nebius -10%、CoreWeave -9%），而不是花钱本身。

**判读**：维持高风险预警，触发的是规则①——估值类红灯 2 个（CAPE 41.5、前五权重 27.6%）叠加资金面红灯 3 个（Mag4 FCF、AI 占 VC 70%、Nvidia 客户投资/收入连续第 8 期红），双类共振强制升级至少到高风险预警；两轴升级未触发（成熟度 60.0 达标，但临近度 36.7 未及 50）。动量净 0（1 恶化 / 1 好转），远未及 ±4 的提示线。历史相似度最高仍是 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）82%，其次 1999-06 的 76%（因广度修正回黄，由上期 72% 上升）。与 2000-02 向量的主要差异集中在五格：龙头远期 PE（当前约 23x，2000 年为红）、市场广度（黄 vs 红）、IPO 管道（黄 vs 红）、HY 利差（绿 vs 黄）、债务/capex 比（黄 vs 红）。这五格里最先转红的那一格就是进入顶部前夜的确认信号——按当前排期，Anthropic 若在 10 月按 $9650 亿以上公开定价挂牌，IPO 管道会是最先亮的一格。

**升级触发**：本期档位由规则①（估值红灯 ≥2 且资金面红灯 ≥3 的双类共振）强制升级至高风险预警；基础档位按红灯比例 28.0% 本为中度警戒。规则②两轴升级未触发，规则③降档滞回不适用（未发生降档）。
summary.verdict_desc_en:
**Bottom line**: The counts and both axis scores are identical to last week — seven red, nine yellow, nine green, a 28.0% risk temperature, maturity at 60.0 and proximity at 36.7 — but that stillness is two large opposing moves cancelling out: the Fed flipped from hold to a priced hike and turned red, while breadth reverted to yellow after last week's questionable 33% proved to be a misread.

**Correction**: Start with last week's heaviest call. Breadth was moved from green straight to red on a reading of about 33% for Aug 21, and that entry warned at the time that all four real-time sources were blocked, that the number rested on a single second-hand source, and that the verdict would revert if it proved wrong. It has. Through the week of Aug 24-28, roughly 54% of S&P 500 members sat above their own 50-day average, down from about 70% in mid-August, with more than 70% still above the 200-day line. The direction was right — only 42% of stocks advanced on the week and three of eleven sectors closed higher while the index gained 0.49%, so the gap between the leaders and the median is real — but the magnitude was not. A 54% reading is nothing like February 2000, when the index printed highs with most members below their averages. This is logged as a data correction rather than genuine improvement, with the entry written into raw_history.

**Policy**: The only true deterioration this week came from the Fed. At Jackson Hole on Aug 28 Kevin Warsh recommitted to the 2% PCE target and said the central bank still has work to do on inflation. Markets read it as unambiguously hawkish: the two-year yield jumped more than twelve basis points to 4.356%, the ten-year rose over five to 4.726%, and CME-implied odds of a September 16 hike went from roughly 35% before the speech to 57-60%. For the first time the modal outcome is a hike rather than a hold, which is red under the tighten-bad rule; the line was last red from late June to mid-July. One vintage caveat matters: high-yield spreads actually tightened twelve basis points to 263, but the FRED observation is dated Aug 27, still before the speech. Credit has not priced the hawkish turn at all, so today's green there is a green as of the day before.

**Contrary evidence**: This week's counter-case is the strongest of the year and it comes almost entirely from Nvidia's Aug 26 print. Revenue of $96.2bn, up 18% sequentially and 106% year on year, data centre revenue of $89bn, next-quarter guidance of $108bn, and a rare fiscal 2028 outlook of about 70% growth against consensus near 44%, followed by an 8.7% gain on Aug 27. Finance chief Colette Kress pointed top-five hyperscaler capex from roughly $800bn in 2026 to about $1.3trn in 2027, disclosed a backlog above $2trn, and AWS committed to two million GPUs. Usage moved the same way: OpenRouter's official data shows 360.0 trillion tokens over thirty days, up 50.0% from the prior thirty against 302.9tn and 32.1% last week, the fastest reading since this measure was adopted. Nothing cracked on the demand or compute side. What cracked is the cost of money — the market punished Broadcom, down 6% on questions about roughly $370bn of AI debt exposure, and the neoclouds, with Nebius off 10% and CoreWeave 9%, rather than spending itself.

**Verdict**: High Risk Alert holds, forced by the first escalation rule rather than by the headline number. Two valuation reds — CAPE at 41.5 and a 27.6% top-five weight — combine with three capital reds in Mag4 free cash flow, AI at 70% of venture funding, and Nvidia's customer investments red for an eighth straight period, which mandates at least this tier. The two-axis rule did not fire: maturity clears its 60 threshold but proximity at 36.7 falls short of 50. Momentum is net zero, one deterioration against one improvement, nowhere near the plus or minus four alert line. Similarity is highest to February 2000, one month before the dot-com top, at 82%, followed by June 1999 at 76% — up from 72% because the breadth correction restored a match. The main divergences from the 2000 vector sit in five places: leader forward multiples, at roughly 23x today against red then; breadth, yellow against red; the IPO pipeline, yellow against red; high-yield spreads, green against yellow; and the debt-to-capex ratio, yellow against red. Whichever of those five turns red first is the confirmation signal for the pre-top phase, and on the current calendar an Anthropic listing priced above $965bn in October would light the IPO line first.

**Escalation**: The tier was forced to High Risk Alert by rule one, the resonance of at least two valuation reds with at least three capital reds. On the 28.0% red share alone the base tier would be Moderate Caution. The two-axis rule did not fire, and the downgrade hysteresis rule does not apply because no downgrade occurred.

wow_changes.note: 本期唯一的真实恶化：8/28 Warsh 在 Jackson Hole 重申 2% PCE 目标、直言控通胀「仍有工作要做」，2 年期收益率单日 +12bp 至 4.356%、10 年期 +5bp 至 4.726%、美元指数 +0.6%。CME 隐含 9/16 加息概率由讲话前约 35% 跳至 57-60%，维持仅 40-43%——模态结果第一次由「维持」翻成「加息」，按 tighten_bad 口径转红（上期 8/20 读数为维持 68.4% / 加息 31.6%）。上一次红灯是 6 月底至 7 月中。
wow_changes.note_en: The only genuine deterioration this week. At Jackson Hole on Aug 28 Kevin Warsh recommitted to the 2% PCE target and said the Fed still has work to do on inflation. The two-year yield jumped twelve basis points to 4.356%, the ten-year rose five to 4.726% and the dollar index gained 0.6%. CME-implied odds of a September 16 hike went from roughly 35% before the speech to 57-60%, with a hold now at just 40-43% — the modal outcome flipped from hold to hike for the first time, which is red under the tighten-bad rule, against 68.4% hold and 31.6% hike on Aug 20. The line was last red from late June to mid-July.

wow_changes.note: 数据修正，不是真实好转。上期 8/21 的 33% 读数当时已注明仅由单一二手源支撑、四个实时源全部受限、下期须优先复核；本期证实为误读——8/24-8/28 当周标普成分股在 50 日线上方约 54%（较 8 月中 70% 回落），200 日线上方仍逾 70%。广度退潮的方向属实（全周仅 42% 个股上涨、11 个板块只有 3 个收高，指数仍涨 0.49%），但不构成 2000 年 2 月式的断裂。
wow_changes.note_en: A data correction rather than an improvement. Last week's 33% print for Aug 21 was flagged at the time as resting on a single second-hand source with all four real-time feeds blocked, and marked for priority recheck. It was a misread: through Aug 24-28 roughly 54% of S&P 500 members closed above their 50-day average, down from about 70% in mid-August, with over 70% still above the 200-day. Breadth is genuinely thinning — only 42% of stocks advanced and three of eleven sectors rose while the index gained 0.49% — but this is not a February 2000 style break.

wow_changes.note: 行业推理需求再上台阶：OpenRouter 官方 API 近 30 日 360.0 万亿 tokens（上期 302.9T），环比由 +32.1% 升至 +50.0%，为本口径启用以来最快；日频尾部 8/25 单日 18.8T 创序列新高。绿灯不变，但在 Fed 转鹰、AI 借款人 CDS 飙升的同一周，这是最硬的反向证据。
wow_changes.note_en: Inference demand stepped up again. OpenRouter's official data shows 360.0 trillion tokens over thirty days against 302.9tn last week, with growth accelerating from 32.1% to 50.0% — the fastest since this measure was adopted — and a record single day of 18.8tn on Aug 25. The light stays green, but in a week when the Fed turned hawkish and swap costs on AI borrowers spiked, this is the hardest contrary evidence available.

wow_changes.note: 绝对卖压 30 日环比 +23.9%（$4.698 亿 → $5.822 亿，SEC EDGAR Form 4 直聚，132 份），买盘仅 $36.6 万、全部来自 TSM。构成高度集中：AMZN 一家 $3.645 亿占 63%，其次 PLTR $9540 万、MU $5280 万、AMD $4870 万。值得单记：NVDA 本窗口内部人卖出为 $0，在史上最强财报与 8/27 涨 8.7% 之后仍无一笔公开市场减持。
wow_changes.note_en: Absolute selling rose 23.9% over the thirty-day window, from $469.8m to $582.2m across 132 Form 4 filings aggregated directly from SEC EDGAR, against just $366,000 of buying, all of it from TSMC. The selling is highly concentrated: Amazon alone accounts for $364.5m, or 63%, followed by Palantir at $95.4m, Micron at $52.8m and AMD at $48.7m. Worth noting separately, Nvidia insiders sold nothing at all in this window, even after a record print and an 8.7% move on Aug 27.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >35 red / 25-35 yellow / <25 green
indicators.note: 本期实抓读数：GuruFocus 41.59（2026-08 月度）、thetrading.tools 41.2（称处 1881 年以来 1748 个月的第 98.9 百分位，历史上只有 18 个月更高、全部落在 1999-2000）、marketcrash 42.17；multpl 主源续 egress 受限。取中值约 41.5，较上期台账 41.2 微升，续处红线 35 之上、1999-2000 峰值 44.19 之下。这是一个月度序列，周度不该期待大幅波动——它的作用是把「泡沫有多大」钉在极端分位上，而不是提供时点信号。
indicators.note_en: Live reads this week: GuruFocus 41.59 for August, thetrading.tools 41.2 — which places the ratio in the 98.9th percentile of 1,748 months since 1881, with only 18 months ever higher and all of them in 1999-2000 — and marketcrash 42.17. Multpl remains blocked by the egress proxy. The midpoint of about 41.5 is marginally above last week's 41.2, still far through the 35 red line and still short of the 44.19 peak. This is a monthly series: it anchors how large the bubble is, not when it breaks.

indicators.name_zh: 标普前 5 大权重占比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >25% red / 18-25% yellow / <18% green
indicators.note: prefetch 机械读（SSGA SPY 官方持仓 XLSX，8/28）：前 5 单类权重合计 27.63%（NVDA 8.29 / AAPL 6.94 / MSFT 5.63 / AMZN 3.77 / GOOGL 3.00），含 Alphabet 双类约 30.03%，top10 37.63%。较上期 27.26% 再升 0.37pt，主要由 NVDA 财报后从 7.98% 回到 8.29% 贡献——单一发行人吃掉指数 8.3% 仍是标普史上最高的个股权重。2000 年峰值约 18%，当前集中度是那次的 1.5 倍。
indicators.note_en: Mechanical read from the prefetch job using SSGA's official SPY holdings file dated Aug 28: the top five single share classes total 27.63% (NVDA 8.29, AAPL 6.94, MSFT 5.63, AMZN 3.77, GOOGL 3.00), rising to about 30.03% if both Alphabet classes are counted, with the top ten at 37.63%. That is up 0.37 points from 27.26%, almost entirely because Nvidia rebounded from 7.98% to 8.29% after its earnings — still the largest single-issuer weight in the index's history. The 2000 peak was near 18%.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >40x red / 30-40x yellow / <30x green
indicators.note: 8/26 财报后本期读数明显分层：StockAnalysis 18.04（8/30，已反映 FY28 一致预期上修）、TrendLyne 23.8、GuruFocus 24.50（8/19，财报前）、FinanceCharts 25.64（8/28）。取中枢约 23x（区间 18.0-25.6），较上期 24x 略降。逻辑要点：股价 8/27 涨 8.7%，但公司罕见给出 FY28 营收 +70% 的年度展望（一致预期约 44%），分母上修快过分子，远期倍数不升反降。全市场最贵的公司之一按远期口径只有约 23 倍——这正是本轮与 2000 年最不像的一格（1999 年 MSFT NTM PE 60x）。
indicators.note_en: Post-earnings readings scatter widely: StockAnalysis 18.04 as of Aug 30 (already reflecting revised FY28 consensus), TrendLyne 23.8, GuruFocus 24.50 dated Aug 19 before the print, and FinanceCharts 25.64 on Aug 28. Centring on roughly 23x, a shade below last week's 24x. The mechanics matter: the stock rose 8.7% on Aug 27, but Nvidia took the rare step of guiding fiscal 2028 revenue growth to about 70% against consensus near 44%, so estimates rose faster than the price and the multiple compressed. One of the most expensive companies in the world trading near 23x forward is the single sharpest contrast with 2000, when Microsoft carried a 60x NTM multiple.

indicators.threshold_text: 转折价/环比下跌 红 / 溢价收窄且卖压>买压 黄 / 溢价稳定或扩大 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Discount or falling marks red / narrowing premium with sellers dominant yellow / stable or widening premium green
indicators.note: 本期首次拿到一个带明确当日日期的成交价：Forge Global 的 OpenAI 挂牌价 8/30 为 $721.85/股。隐含估值一侧仍是老数：Anthropic Caplight 约 $1.2T（较 $965B Series H 溢价约 24%）、OpenAI Caplight 约 $908B（较 $852B 溢价约 7%），两家旗舰均无转折价。Rainmaker Securities CEO 称 $1.2T 价位确有成交，但「卖方几近于无、成交寥寥」——买盘压过卖盘，属绿灯情形。**仍标 suspect_static**：$1.2T / $908B 这两个核心隐含估值锚已连续 5 期逐位不变，本期新拿到的 Forge 单价属另一字段、不构成对该锚的刷新；本期起把 $721.85 记入台账，下期即可算出真实环比。Anthropic 若 10 月按公开定价挂牌，IPO 价格将直接取代二级标价成为这条线的读数。
indicators.note_en: For the first time in five weeks there is a mark with a hard same-day date: Forge Global lists OpenAI at $721.85 a share on Aug 30. The implied-valuation side is unchanged — Caplight has Anthropic near $1.2trn, about 24% above the $965bn Series H, and OpenAI near $908bn, some 7% above its $852bn round — and neither flagship trades at a discount. Rainmaker Securities' chief executive says trades do clear at the $1.2trn level but that closings are rare because almost nobody is selling; demand over supply is the green case. The suspect-static flag stays on: those two implied valuations have not moved a digit in five periods, and the new Forge quote is a different field rather than a refresh of that anchor. It is logged this week so a genuine week-on-week change can be computed next time. An October Anthropic listing would replace this line with a public price.

indicators.name_zh: 超大规模厂商资本开支同比
indicators.threshold_text: 下调指引 红 / 加速本身 黄 / 稳健 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut red / acceleration itself yellow / steady green
indicators.note: 本期有硬新读点，且是把路径拉得更长的方向。Nvidia CFO Colette Kress 在 8/26 电话会给出前五大 hyperscaler 的 capex 路径：2026 年约 $8000 亿 → 2027 年约 $1.3 万亿（+62.5%），并披露在手订单逾 $2 万亿；同时 AWS 宣布采购 200 万颗 Nvidia GPU 并启用新的 Vera CPU。2026 年口径（大五合计 $7750-8000 亿、同比约 +80%）与上期一致，新增的是 2027 年这一档。按 extreme_bad 口径，加速本身即为黄——没有任何一家下调指引，故不红；但连续两年 60-80% 的增速本身就是不可持续的定义，黄灯的含义是「高度亢奋、尚未见拐点」。
indicators.note_en: A genuinely new reading this week, and it extends the runway rather than shortening it. On the Aug 26 call, Nvidia finance chief Colette Kress put top-five hyperscaler capex at roughly $800bn in 2026 rising to about $1.3trn in 2027, a 62.5% increase, and disclosed a backlog above $2trn. AWS separately committed to two million Nvidia GPUs and the new Vera CPU. The 2026 figure — $775-800bn for the big five, up around 80% — is unchanged; the 2027 path is the new information. Under the extreme-bad rule acceleration alone scores yellow: nobody has cut guidance, so this is not red, but two consecutive years of 60-80% growth is close to the textbook definition of unsustainable. Yellow here means euphoric and not yet turning.

indicators.threshold_text_en: <-20% red / -20% to 0% yellow / >0% green
indicators.note: 季度指标，本期无新披露，沿用已落地的 Q2 台账：Meta Q2 自由现金流仅 $7.84 亿、Amazon 滚动十二月 -$76 亿、Alphabet Q2 -$58.55 亿（其史上首次经营现金流转负）、MSFT 财年 Q4 $196 亿；Alphabet 上半年有息负债 +111% 至 $980 亿。资本开支正在系统性吞掉四家的自有燃料，2027 年 $1.3 万亿的 capex 路径只会把缺口拉大——自有现金烧完转向外部融资，正是把本指标与信用面几格串起来的那根线。下一次真实读点是 10 月下旬的 Q3 财报。
indicators.note_en: A quarterly series with nothing new to report, so the settled Q2 ledger carries: Meta generated just $784m of free cash flow, Amazon ran at minus $7.6bn on a trailing twelve-month basis, Alphabet posted minus $5.86bn and its first ever negative operating cash flow quarter, and Microsoft managed $19.6bn in fiscal Q4. Alphabet's interest-bearing debt rose 111% in the first half to $98bn. Capital spending is systematically consuming the group's own fuel, and the $1.3trn 2027 capex path only widens the gap. Running out of internal cash and turning to external funding is precisely the thread linking this line to the credit indicators. Next real read: Q3 results in late October.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >50% red / 30-50% yellow / <30% green
indicators.note: 本期复核确认 Q3 2026 完整占比仍未发布（PitchBook / Crunchbase 均待 10 月初），H1 2026 续为最新硬数据：全球 AI 占创投 70%、美国 86%，全球上半年创投总额 $5100 亿，其中 OpenAI + Anthropic 两家就吃掉 $2170 亿。本期新增的交叉印证是 Q1 口径——Crunchbase 记 Q1 2026 全球创投 $2970-3310 亿、AI 占 80-81%，为该序列有记录以来最高。健康水位 <30%，当前是它的 2.3 倍；这一格已红了整整 19 期快照，是「泡沫有多大」而非「何时破」的读数。
indicators.note_en: Rechecked this week: the full Q3 2026 share is still unpublished — both PitchBook and Crunchbase are due in early October — so first-half data remains the hard anchor. AI took 70% of global venture funding and 86% of the US total, out of $510bn raised worldwide, with OpenAI and Anthropic alone absorbing $217bn. The new cross-check is the Q1 cut: Crunchbase puts global venture at $297-331bn for the quarter with AI at 80-81%, the highest share on record for the series. A healthy level is under 30%, so this sits at more than twice that, and it has been red for nineteen straight snapshots. It measures how big the bubble is, not when it pops.

indicators.name_zh: 英伟达客户投资占收入比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >30% red / 15-30% yellow / <15% green
indicators.note: 台账内连续第 8 期红（快照口径第 20 期）。上期预告的分母更新本期落地：Q2 FY27 营收 $962 亿入账后，LTM 收入由约 $3000 亿升至约 $3050 亿，比值机械下移不足 1pt，仍约 43%——近 Lucent 1999 年 vendor financing 峰值 24% 的两倍。分子侧本期有两个硬数：① 10-Q 口径可交易权益证券由去年同期 $129 亿增至 $302 亿（+134%），这是整条线里唯一经审计的绝对值；② BofA 把 Nvidia 对各 AI 实验室的全口径股权承诺估到约 $700 亿（含 OpenAI $300 亿、Anthropic 至多 $100 亿）。二阶方向本期由上期的「收敛」重新转为扩张：8/12 与 Apollo / BlackRock / Blackstone / Brookfield / 高盛 / KKR 组建的融资平台落地、目标动员逾 $5000 亿，另有 $129 亿收购 Hugging Face 待交割；唯一仍站在收敛一侧的是 8/17 SEC 文件把俄亥俄背书封顶在 $1050 亿。
indicators.note_en: Red for an eighth consecutive ledger period and a twentieth consecutive snapshot. The denominator update flagged last week has landed: with $96.2bn of Q2 FY27 revenue booked, trailing twelve-month revenue rises from roughly $300bn to about $305bn, mechanically shaving less than a point off the ratio, which stays near 43% — around twice Lucent's 24% vendor-financing peak in 1999. Two hard numbers arrived on the numerator side. Marketable equity securities on the 10-Q rose to $30.2bn from $12.9bn a year earlier, up 134%, and it is the only audited absolute figure on this line. Bank of America now pegs Nvidia's all-in equity commitments across the AI labs at about $70bn, including $30bn for OpenAI and up to $10bn for Anthropic. The second derivative, which turned to contraction last week, has flipped back to expansion: the Aug 12 financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR aim to mobilise over $500bn, and a $12.9bn Hugging Face purchase is pending. The one restraint remains the Aug 17 filing capping the Ohio backstop at $105bn.

indicators.name_zh: 标普 50 日线上方比例
indicators.threshold_text_en: <40% red / 40-60% yellow / >60% green
indicators.note: **本期是一次数据修正，不是真实好转。** 上期把这一格由绿直接打到红（8/21 约 33%），当时已按纪律注明「四个实时源全部 egress 受限，33% 仅由单一二手源支撑，下期须优先复核；若证实为误读，判读退回上期格局」。本期复核证实为误读：截至 8/24-8/28 当周，标普成分股在自身 50 日线上方的比例约 54%（较 8 月中的 70% 回落），200 日线上方仍逾 70%（偏强读数）。方向没有错——广度确实在退潮：全周仅 42% 个股上涨、11 个板块只有 3 个收高，而指数仍涨 0.49%，头部与中位数的裂口真实存在。但量级不是腰斩到 33%，不构成 2000 年 2 月那种「指数新高、半数以上个股跌破均线」的断裂，故红→黄。已在 raw_history.corrections 记入更正。
indicators.note_en: This is a data correction, not an improvement. Last week the line was moved straight from green to red on a reading of about 33% for Aug 21, and that entry already warned that all four real-time sources were blocked by the egress proxy, that 33% rested on a single second-hand source, and that the verdict would revert if the number proved wrong. It did. Through the week of Aug 24-28 roughly 54% of S&P 500 members closed above their own 50-day average, down from about 70% in mid-August, while more than 70% remain above the 200-day line, which is a strong reading. The direction was right — breadth is thinning, with only 42% of stocks advancing on the week and three of eleven sectors higher even as the index gained 0.49% — but the magnitude was not. A 54% reading is nothing like the February 2000 break where the index made highs while most members sat below their averages. Red to yellow, with the correction logged in raw_history.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >20x red / 5-20x yellow / <5x green
indicators.note: prefetch 机械聚合（SEC EDGAR Form 4，12 家，窗口 2026-07-31~08-30，共 132 份）：30 日公开市场卖出 $5.822 亿 / 买入 $36.6 万，比值 1590.8x（买盘近零，比值对分母极敏感，value 按规则封顶 99）。绝对卖压是这条线的真读数：$5.822 亿较上期 $4.698 亿增 23.9%，且构成高度集中——AMZN $3.645 亿一家占 63%，其次 PLTR $9540 万、MU $5280 万、AMD $4870 万。一个值得单记的细节：本期 NVDA 内部人卖出为 $0（3 份 Form 4），在史上最强财报与 8/27 涨 8.7% 之后仍无一笔公开市场减持——与 AMZN 的集中抛售形成鲜明对照。买盘方向唯一的 $36.6 万来自 TSM（35 份 Form 4）。
indicators.note_en: Mechanically aggregated by the prefetch job from SEC Form 4 filings across twelve issuers for the thirty days to Aug 30, covering 132 filings: $582.2m of open-market sales against $366,000 of purchases, a ratio of 1590.8x. With buying near zero the ratio is unbounded and hypersensitive to its denominator, so the recorded value is capped at 99. The absolute sell figure is the honest read, and it rose 23.9% from $469.8m. It is also highly concentrated: Amazon alone accounts for $364.5m, or 63%, followed by Palantir at $95.4m, Micron at $52.8m and AMD at $48.7m. One detail worth flagging on its own: Nvidia insiders sold nothing at all this window across three filings, even after a record print and an 8.7% move on Aug 27. The only buying, $366,000 of it, came from TSMC.

indicators.threshold_text: 10+ 家洪流 红 / 3-9 家升温 黄 / <3 家平静 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: 10+ deluge red / 3-9 heating yellow / <3 quiet green
indicators.note: 按定义口径数「未来 6 个月内实质排队的 AI 发行」：Anthropic（保密 S-1，公开招股书预计 9 月、路演至 10 月初、首日交易目标 10 月，最近一轮 $9650 亿）、Standard Nuclear、Syntiant、Southport Acquisition II（$2 亿、明确以 AI 数据/安全/流程自动化为标的的 SPAC）、Thunder Bridge V（$2.61 亿，8/13 定价）、BOA Acquisition II（$1.25 亿，8/4 定价）、Volato / Alignment Engine 反向合并（8/26-28 签定，作价 $5 亿，标的含 154MW 在运、可扩至 480MW 的数据中心园区）——7 家，仍在 3-9 的黄区。本期有一处降温：OpenAI 已被 Bloomberg 报道推迟至 2027（市场波动 + Altman 坚持 $1 万亿定价底线），把管道里体量最大的一单挪出了 6 个月窗口。年内已完成的 11 家（SpaceX 约 $1.77 万亿、SK 海力士约 $1 万亿、Cerebras 等）是已实现供给、不计入管道。**这仍是最接近转红的一格**：Anthropic 10 月一旦按 $9650 亿以上公开定价，本指标即触及洪流门槛。
indicators.note_en: Counting AI issuers genuinely queued for the next six months: Anthropic, whose confidential S-1 is expected to go public in September with a roadshow into early October and a first trade targeted for that month against a $965bn last round; Standard Nuclear; Syntiant; Southport Acquisition II, a $200m blank-cheque vehicle explicitly hunting AI data, security and workflow targets; Thunder Bridge V at $261m, priced Aug 13; BOA Acquisition II at $125m, priced Aug 4; and the Volato-Alignment Engine reverse merger signed Aug 26-28 at a $500m valuation, bringing 154MW of live data centre capacity with a path to 480MW. Seven names keeps this inside the 3-9 yellow band. One thing cooled this week: Bloomberg reports OpenAI has slipped to 2027 on market volatility and Sam Altman's insistence on a $1trn price, removing the largest single deal from the six-month window. The eleven listings already completed this year, SpaceX near $1.77trn and SK Hynix near $1trn among them, are realised supply rather than pipeline. This remains the closest line to turning red: an October Anthropic pricing above $965bn would take it to the deluge threshold.

indicators.name_zh: 高收益债期权调整利差
indicators.threshold_text: >500bps 红 / 350-500bps 黄 / <350bps 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: >500bps red / 350-500bps yellow / <350bps green
indicators.note: prefetch 机械读（FRED 官方 API，BAMLH0A0HYM2）：263 bps，观测日 2026-08-27；近五个观测 263 / 267 / 270 / 269 / 270。较上期 275bps 收窄 12bp，重回本轮最紧十分位，距 350bps 黄线仍有 87bp、距 500bps 红线 237bp。**必须写明的口径滞后**：8/27 的观测日仍在 Warsh 8/28 Jackson Hole 讲话之前——FRED 该序列有一日发布时滞，本期即便用当日（8/30）抓取的 prefetch 也只能拿到 8/27 的观测，信用面完全没有为那次鹰派转向定价（2 年期收益率当日跳 12bp、加息概率由 35% 翻到 57-60%）。也就是说这一格的绿灯是「截至讲话前」的绿灯，下期才是它真正的检验。
indicators.note_en: Mechanical read from the FRED API series BAMLH0A0HYM2: 263 basis points as of Aug 27, with the last five observations at 263, 267, 270, 269 and 270. That is twelve basis points tighter than last week and back in the tightest decile of this cycle, 87bp from the yellow line and 237bp from red. The vintage matters and has to be stated: even a same-day prefetch run only reaches the Aug 27 observation because the series publishes with a day's lag, and Aug 27 still predates Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech on Aug 28. Credit has not priced the hawkish turn at all — the two-year yield jumped twelve basis points that day and hike odds went from 35% to 57-60%. This is a green light as of the day before the speech, and next week is its real test.

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.value_display: 分层：ABS 偏紧·公司债走阔
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ 红 / 稳定 黄 / 收窄 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: 50bps+ widening red / stable yellow / tightening green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，但本期的证据结构与上期不同，值得说清楚——ABS 与公司债明确劈叉。ABS 一侧转好：Morgan Stanley 明确写 AI 债务供给冲击已让 hyperscaler 与数据中心**公司债**利差显著走阔，但数据中心 ABS「明显更有韧性、利差仍在年内最紧附近」；Green Street 亦以「data-center ABS spreads race back in」为题记录利差回收。量的一侧续扩：Barclays 记 DC ABS 存量由 2020 年 $40 亿升至 2026 年至今 $610 亿，上半年 SASB/CMBS + ABS 合计 $170 亿、同比 +29%。**但不给绿灯**，两个理由：① 上期转黄的依据（DC 相关 CMBS 被迫在初始指引之上定价、hyperscaler 对 IG 利差由 20-25bps 扩至约 35bps、认购覆盖由 5 倍降至不足 2 倍）本期没有任何一条被推翻；② SEC 7/29 的解释函确认数据中心证券化不属 1934 法下的「资产支持证券」，ABS 当前的紧俏里含有一层监管松绑带来的供给便利，而非纯粹的信用需求。既非 50bps+ 全面走阔（红），也不是干净的收窄（绿）——稳定/分层，黄。
indicators.note_en: Still yellow, but the evidence has changed shape and the split is worth spelling out: securitised and corporate data-centre credit have decoupled. The ABS side improved. Morgan Stanley writes that the surge in AI-related debt has driven meaningful widening across hyperscaler and data-centre corporate credit, while data-centre ABS has been notably more resilient with spreads still near year-to-date tights; Green Street headlines the same move as spreads racing back in. Volume keeps building — Barclays tracks outstanding data-centre ABS from $4bn in 2020 to $61bn so far in 2026, with $17bn of first-half SASB, CMBS and ABS issuance, up 29% year on year. Two reasons not to hand back the green light. Nothing has overturned last week's basis for the downgrade: data-centre CMBS deals still had to price above initial talk, hyperscaler spreads to broad investment grade have widened from 20-25bp in early 2025 to about 35bp, and order books thinned from roughly five times covered in February to under two by July. And the SEC's July 29 interpretive letter, confirming data-centre securitisations fall outside the 1934 Act definition of an asset-backed security, means part of today's tightness is regulatory relief rather than credit demand. Neither a 50bp broad widening nor a clean tightening: stable and split, so yellow.

indicators.threshold_text: 已确认事件 红 / Watch 评级 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed event red / on watch yellow / none green
indicators.note: 仍无评级机构层面的违约、下调或压力交换，按口径维持黄灯——但本期的边际是往红的方向走的，而且第一次出现「评级实际卡住了一笔融资」。三条实证：① CoreWeave 五年期 CDS 续在约 855bps，按常用模型隐含约 50% 的五年违约概率；② 有报道称 Blue Owl 一笔 $40 亿的 CoreWeave 数据中心融资因其 B+ 评级而告吹（Blue Owl 否认存在融资困难）；③ AI 基建借款人的 CDS 成本整体飙升，带动 Nebius 单日 -10%、CoreWeave -9%，两者近一个月分别 -43% 与 -36%。基本面并不弱——CoreWeave Q2 营收 $25.8 亿、同比 +112%，在手订单 $1042 亿——问题全在融资端：Q1 利息支出翻倍至 $5.36 亿、自由现金流 -$47.1 亿。这一格与 fed_policy 本期转红是同一件事的两端。
indicators.note_en: Still no rating-agency default, downgrade or distressed exchange, so the letter of the rule keeps this yellow — but the margin moved toward red, and for the first time a rating appears to have actually blocked a financing. Three data points. CoreWeave's five-year credit default swaps remain near 855 basis points, implying roughly a 50% five-year default probability on standard models. A $4bn Blue Owl financing for a CoreWeave data centre was reported to have fallen through on the company's B+ rating, which Blue Owl denies. And swap costs across AI-infrastructure borrowers spiked hard enough to knock Nebius down 10% and CoreWeave 9% in a session, leaving them 43% and 36% lower over the month. The operating business is not the problem: CoreWeave posted $2.58bn of Q2 revenue, up 112%, on a $104.2bn backlog. The funding side is — interest expense doubled to $536m in Q1 against negative $4.71bn of free cash flow. This line and the Fed turning red this week are two ends of the same story.

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green
indicators.note: 周度增量台账（距 8/9 完整对账 21 天，未到 28 天，本期不做完整拆解；下次对账最早 9/6）。**本周边际：无新确认的债务 deal**——这本身是上周 $705 亿爆量之后的显著回落，也是有意义的边际信息。两处需要交代：① 8/26-28 的 Volato / Alignment Engine 交易作价 $5 亿，属股权反向合并、不是债务，不计入台账；② 上周记入的 Broadcom $700 亿本周细节更新——市场传闻区间抬到 $700-800 亿（优先约 $450 亿 + 次级约 $350 亿，Bloomberg 称总额或达 $1000 亿，Blackstone / Apollo 参与），结构走 SPV、复制其 6 月 $350 亿 Anthropic 算力交易的架构，仍**在市未定价**，故金额维持 $700 亿不上调。台账年内可追溯流水维持约 $1995 亿（14 笔）——提醒：该台账自 6 月中才开始逐笔记录，是增量流水而非全年普查，其 run-rate 不可直接与 MS 锚定值比较。比值维持约 55%（区间 50-60%）：分子锚 Morgan Stanley 全口径 2026E 约 $5700 亿（公开债 + 私募信用 + ABS + JV/SPV），分母全口径 capex 约 $1.04 万亿。
indicators.note_en: Weekly incremental ledger; 21 days since the Aug 9 full reconciliation, short of the 28-day trigger, so no bottom-up rebuild this week and the next is due Sept 6 at the earliest. The weekly margin is zero: no newly confirmed debt deal. After last week's $70.5bn surge that drop is itself information. Two points of housekeeping. The Volato-Alignment Engine transaction signed Aug 26-28 is a $500m equity reverse merger, not debt, and is excluded. And the Broadcom facility booked last week gained detail rather than size — the reported range widened to $70-80bn, roughly $45bn senior and $35bn junior, with Bloomberg suggesting the total could reach $100bn and Blackstone and Apollo in talks, routed through an SPV mirroring the architecture of June's $35bn Anthropic compute deal. It remains in market and unpriced, so the ledger entry stays at $70bn. Traceable flow for the year holds near $199.5bn across fourteen deals, with the caveat that this ledger only began recording individual transactions in mid-June: it is an incremental record, not a full-year census, and its run rate cannot be compared directly with the Morgan Stanley anchor. The ratio holds near 55%, range 50-60%, against a $570bn all-in 2026 numerator covering public bonds, private credit, ABS and JV/SPV structures, over roughly $1.04trn of all-in capex.

indicators.name_zh: 行业 Token 量月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contracting red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: prefetch 机械读（OpenRouter 官方 datasets API rankings-daily，数据截至 8/29）：近 30 日 360.0 万亿 tokens，前 30 日 240.1 万亿，环比 +50.0%。这是本监测有此口径以来最快的一期——上期 302.9T / +32.1%，再上期 275.0T / +25.9%，绝对量与增速连续三期同向加速。日频尾部创新高：8/25 单日 18.8T、8/24 与 8/26 各 18.4T，均高于上期序列高点 14.1T；8/28-8/29 回落至 15.1T / 13.2T 属周末常态。在 Fed 转鹰、广度退潮、AI 基建借款人 CDS 飙升的同一周，底层推理需求非但没走软，还上了一个台阶——这是本期最硬的反向证据。
indicators.note_en: Mechanical read from OpenRouter's official rankings-daily dataset through Aug 29: 360.0 trillion tokens over the trailing thirty days against 240.1 trillion in the prior thirty, a 50.0% increase. That is the fastest reading since this measure was adopted — last week was 302.9tn and 32.1%, the week before 275.0tn and 25.9%, so both the absolute volume and the growth rate have accelerated three periods running. The daily tail set records too, with 18.8tn on Aug 25 and 18.4tn on both Aug 24 and 26, all above the prior series high of 14.1tn; the drop to 15.1tn and 13.2tn on Aug 28-29 is the usual weekend pattern. In the same week the Fed turned hawkish, breadth thinned and swap costs on AI-infrastructure borrowers spiked, underlying inference demand did not merely hold up — it stepped up. This is the hardest contrary evidence on the board.

indicators.threshold_text: 环比 -15%+ 或普遍过剩 红 / 温和阴跌 黄 / 稳定或紧俏 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Down 15%+ or broad oversupply red / mild drift lower yellow / stable or tight green
indicators.note: 本期实抓价点：H100 跨 15+ 提供商 $1.49-6.98/hr（Vast.ai 起 $1.49、RunPod $1.99、Lambda $3.99、CoreWeave $4.25、hyperscaler 上至 $6.98），同业中位数约 $3.38/GPU-hr；spot 最低触及 $0.61/hr；H200 较 H100 溢价 20-40%。与台账上期（H100 $2.19-11.06、spot $1.03-2.00，H200 $3.99-4.50）比，主力价位区间高度重叠、无 >15% 的普遍下跌，维持绿灯。**两个需要留意的细节**：① 市场化 spot 底价由 $1.03 降至 $0.61——但两期取自不同提供商集合（本期含 Vast.ai 竞价市场），不可当作干净的环比，只作为离散度扩大的软信号记录；② 反向侧，Nvidia 已宣布 2026 年 H100 租价上调约 20%，与「供过于求」叙事直接冲突。算力商品价格是本体系里唯一直接看供需成交价的一格，2000 年暗光纤正是在电信股崩盘前先崩——这格由绿转黄将是极重的信号，下期须用同一提供商集合复核。
indicators.note_en: Prices captured this week: H100 hourly rates run $1.49 to $6.98 across more than fifteen providers, from Vast.ai at the low end through RunPod at $1.99, Lambda at $3.99 and CoreWeave at $4.25 up to hyperscalers near $6.98, with a cohort median around $3.38 per GPU-hour. The cheapest spot instance touched $0.61 an hour. H200s carry a 20-40% premium to H100s. Set against last week's ledger — H100 $2.19 to $11.06 with spot at $1.03-2.00, H200 at $3.99-4.50 — the core price band overlaps heavily and there is no broad decline anywhere near the 15% threshold, so this stays green. Two details deserve attention. The marketplace spot floor fell from $1.03 to $0.61, but the two readings come from different provider sets, this week's including the Vast.ai bidding marketplace, so it is logged as a soft signal of widening dispersion rather than a clean week-on-week move. On the other side, Nvidia has announced roughly a 20% increase in H100 rental pricing for 2026, which sits awkwardly with any oversupply narrative. This is the only line that watches the clearing price of compute itself, and dark fibre collapsed before telecom equities did in 2000. A move to yellow here would carry heavy weight; next week needs a like-for-like provider set.

indicators.threshold_text: 减速 红 / 平稳 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decelerating red / flat yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，本期无新披露。台账数字：Anthropic 年化 run rate 7 月底约 $650 亿（4 月约 $300 亿 → 5 月底 $470 亿 → 7 月底 $650 亿，两个月月均 +$90 亿，较更早的月均 +$170 亿明显放缓，二阶导为负）；OpenAI 约 $400 亿、月约 $33 亿，7 月单月环比 +20%，较春季长期卡在 $250 亿明确再加速。一加一减对冲，方向不明。**本期按纪律标 suspect_static**：OpenAI 的 $400 亿已连续 4 期逐位未更新、Anthropic 的 $650 亿连续 2 期未更新，两家都不是活源、披露高度依赖媒体口径与公司节奏。Anthropic 若 9 月释出公开 S-1，届时招股书的经审计口径会一次性替代这里的全部二手估算——那也是这条线第一次能算出真正可比的二阶导。
indicators.note_en: Yellow holds; nothing new was disclosed this week. The ledger stands at roughly $65bn annualised for Anthropic at end-July, having run from about $30bn in April to $47bn in late May, implying $9bn a month over the latest stretch against $17bn a month earlier — a negative second derivative. OpenAI sits near $40bn, about $3.3bn a month, having posted 20% month-on-month growth in July after months stuck around $25bn, which is a clear reacceleration. One accelerating and one decelerating leaves the direction genuinely unresolved. The suspect-static flag goes on this week under the anti-anchoring rule: OpenAI's $40bn has not moved a digit in four periods and Anthropic's $65bn in two, and neither is a live source — both depend on press reporting and company timing. If Anthropic publishes its S-1 in September, audited figures will replace every second-hand estimate here at once, and it will be the first time this line yields a genuinely comparable second derivative.

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: 季度调查，本期仍无新的整体生产化读数，沿用 McKinsey Q1 2026 的 72%（2024 年 55%、2020 年 20%），总体部署率高位维持绿灯。分层证据不变且仍是这一格真正的风险：agent 口径生产化仅 31%，McKinsey 称任一业务职能内规模化 agent 的企业不超过 10%，Gartner 预测 2027 年前逾 40% 的 agentic AI 项目会因 ROI 不清、成本失控与风控不足被取消，而 Q1 新发或更新的企业应用中已有 80% 内嵌至少一个 agent。「装上了」与「用起来了」之间的裂口若在下一次调查里体现为头条读数回落，本指标的绿灯含金量会明显下降。下一次真实读点预计在 Q3 调查发布时。
indicators.note_en: A quarterly survey with no new headline reading, so McKinsey's 72% from Q1 2026 carries — up from 55% in 2024 and 20% in 2020 — and the top-line deployment rate stays green. The layered evidence beneath it is unchanged and remains the real risk on this line: only 31% report agents in production, McKinsey finds no more than 10% of firms have scaled agents within any single business function, and Gartner expects more than 40% of agentic AI projects to be cancelled before 2027 on unclear return, runaway cost and thin controls — even as 80% of enterprise applications launched or updated in Q1 already embed at least one agent. The gap between installed and actually used is what matters; if it shows up in the next survey's headline number, the value of this green light drops sharply. Next real read comes with the Q3 survey.

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Shrinking red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 季度指标，本期复核确认无新披露，Q2/FY26Q4 数字不变：MSFT 商业 RPO $6780 亿（+84% YoY，加权久期仅 2.3 年、其中未来 12 个月内确认的部分本身 +37%）、AWS $4960 亿、Google 积压 $5140 亿、Oracle RPO $6380 亿，大三合计逾 $1.1 万亿。本期新增的同向佐证来自 Nvidia：在手订单逾 $2 万亿、AWS 承诺采购 200 万颗 GPU——订单侧与积压侧本期是完全一致的加速。绿灯不变；结构性隐患也不变：Oracle 的积压高度集中于 OpenAI，与 ai_ipo_pipeline、nvda_invest_revenue 是同一个交易对手风险的三个切面。下一次真实读点是 10 月下旬起的 Q3 财报季。
indicators.note_en: A quarterly series, rechecked with nothing new to add, so the Q2 and fiscal Q4 figures stand: Microsoft's commercial remaining performance obligations at $678bn, up 84%, with a weighted duration of only 2.3 years and the portion converting within twelve months itself growing 37%; AWS at $496bn; Google's backlog at $514bn; Oracle at $638bn — over $1.1trn across the big three. Nvidia added a corroborating data point this week with a backlog above $2trn and an AWS commitment to two million GPUs. Bookings and backlog are accelerating in step. Green holds, and so does the structural concern: Oracle's backlog is heavily concentrated in OpenAI, making this line, the IPO pipeline and Nvidia's customer investments three views of one counterparty. Next real read arrives with Q3 earnings from late October.

indicators.threshold_text: 连续两季无实质提升 红 / 放缓 黄 / 90 天内 SOTA 相对 +10% 或 METR 倍增 ≤7 月 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Two quarters flat red / slowing yellow / SOTA up 10%+ in 90 days or METR doubling under 7 months green
indicators.note: 三层判定，绿灯维持但本期是「无新进展、旧进展仍在窗口内」而非再创新高。**辅锚**：BenchLM 8/27 榜单 HLE SOTA 仍为 Claude Opus 5 的 64.7%（次为 Claude Mythos 5 64.5%、Muse Spark 1.1 62.1%），与台账 8/22 逐位一致；对比台账上上期 53.3%，90 天内相对提升 +21%，仍在绿灯门槛之上但已是同一笔进展的第二期计入。ARC-AGI-3 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 7.8% 亦无更新。**本期新增的口径警告**：同为 8/27，PricePerToken 榜给出的 HLE 榜首是 Claude Fable 5 的 55.5%（Opus 5 54.9%、GPT-5.6 Sol 49.5%），与 BenchLM 的 64.7% 差 9pp——原因是各追踪站混用工具增强与闭卷协议，带搜索/代码执行的模型和闭卷模型考的不是同一张卷。台账自本期起同时记录两套口径，避免下期因换源产生假位移。**主锚**：METR 官方全期倍增 196 天（约 6.4 月）口径不变，仍在 ≤7 月轨道内。判定：green，但若下期 HLE SOTA 第三期停在 64.7%，本格将触发同值预警并需重新评估是否转黄。
indicators.note_en: Three-layer assessment; green holds, but this week reads as no new progress with prior progress still inside the window rather than a fresh high. On the secondary anchor, BenchLM's Aug 27 board still shows Claude Opus 5 leading Humanity's Last Exam at 64.7%, with Claude Mythos 5 at 64.5% and Muse Spark 1.1 at 62.1% — identical to the Aug 22 ledger entry. Against the 53.3% recorded a period earlier that is a 21% relative gain inside ninety days, comfortably over the green threshold, but it is the same advance being counted a second time. GPT-5.6 Sol's 7.8% on ARC-AGI-3 is likewise unchanged. A methodology warning belongs here: on the same Aug 27, PricePerToken shows Claude Fable 5 topping HLE at 55.5%, with Opus 5 at 54.9% and GPT-5.6 Sol at 49.5% — nine points below BenchLM. Trackers mix tool-assisted and closed-book protocols, and a model with search and code execution is not sitting the same exam. Both readings are now logged so a source switch next week cannot masquerade as movement. On the primary anchor, METR's official full-period doubling time of 196 days, about 6.4 months, is unchanged and inside the seven-month track. If HLE SOTA sits at 64.7% for a third period, this line trips the static-value warning and the case for yellow needs revisiting.

indicators.name_zh: 会计造假/循环交易事件
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认 红 / 调查中 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed red / under investigation yellow / none green
indicators.note: 仍无针对核心 AI 龙头的正式立案或已确认事件，按口径维持绿灯——但本期第一次出现了具名标的的具体会计质疑，这一格的脆度在上升。实证：Cape Fear Advisors 8 月指出 CoreWeave 把 $13 亿从递延收入重分类到一个新披露的客户科目，质疑其收入确认口径与对少数大客户的高度依赖（CoreWeave Q2 营收 $25.8 亿、+112%，在手订单 $1042 亿）。这属于第三方研究机构的质疑，既非监管立案也非审计师保留意见，故不足以转黄。监管侧工具箱续硬化：SEC 8/5 新设财报与会计执法单元，审查部把 AI 列为 2026 年常设检查优先项、逐字核查发行人对自身 AI 能力的表述。老关切（Nvidia→OpenAI→CoreWeave/Oracle 的循环性）仍停留在分析师层面，但 8/17 那笔 $1050 亿俄亥俄担保已把这一结构写进 SEC 文件。工具箱已就位、案子尚未来——这仍是全部绿灯里最脆的一格。
indicators.note_en: No formal case or confirmed event at a major AI name, so the letter of the rule keeps this green — but for the first time there is a specific accounting question attached to a named company, and the line is getting more fragile. Cape Fear Advisors flagged in August that CoreWeave reclassified $1.3bn out of deferred revenue into a newly disclosed customer account, questioning its revenue recognition and its dependence on a handful of large customers, against $2.58bn of Q2 revenue up 112% and a $104.2bn backlog. That is third-party research, not a regulatory action or an auditor qualification, and it is not enough for yellow. The enforcement toolkit keeps hardening: the SEC stood up a financial reporting and accounting enforcement unit on Aug 5, and the examinations division has made AI a standing 2026 priority, checking issuers' claims about their own AI capabilities line by line. The older circularity concern running from Nvidia through OpenAI to CoreWeave and Oracle still lives at the analyst level, though the $105bn Ohio backstop filed on Aug 17 put the structure itself into an SEC document. The tools are in place and the case has not arrived. This remains the most brittle green on the board.

indicators.threshold_text: 隐含加息 红 / 维持高利率 黄 / 隐含降息 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike priced red / high-for-long yellow / cut priced green
indicators.note: **由黄转红，是本期唯一的真实恶化。** 8/28 Warsh 在 Jackson Hole 的主旨演讲被市场读为明确鹰派：他重申 2% PCE 目标、直言控通胀「仍有工作要做」，并把居高不下的物价定为央行首要关切。即时反应：2 年期收益率单日跳升逾 12bp 至 4.356%、10 年期升逾 5bp 至 4.726%、美元指数 +0.6% 至 99.66、纳斯达克盘中 -0.3%。定价上，CME 对 9/16 会议隐含的加息概率由讲话前约 35% 跳至 57-60%（对应目标区间升至 3.75-4.00%），维持仅 40-43%——**模态结果第一次由「维持」翻成「加息」**，按 tighten_bad 口径即为红灯。对比上期读数（8/20：维持 68.4% / 加息 31.6%）可见这是一次单周内的完整翻转。本指标上一次红灯是 6 月底至 7 月中，随后回黄。要点：这也把上期 note 里指出的缺口补上了——此前实际收紧来自长端期限溢价、本指标看不见；这次收紧直接落在政策路径上，指标定义与现实重新对齐。
indicators.note_en: Yellow to red, and the only genuine deterioration this week. Kevin Warsh's keynote at Jackson Hole on Aug 28 was read as unambiguously hawkish: he recommitted to the 2% PCE target, said the central bank still has work to do on inflation, and named elevated prices as its primary focus. The reaction was immediate — the two-year yield jumped more than twelve basis points to 4.356%, the ten-year rose over five to 4.726%, the dollar index gained 0.6% to 99.66 and the Nasdaq slipped 0.3% intraday. In pricing terms, CME-implied odds of a hike at the Sept 16 meeting went from roughly 35% before the speech to 57-60%, which would lift the target range to 3.75-4.00%, against 40-43% for a hold. For the first time the modal outcome is a hike rather than a hold, which under the tighten-bad rule is red. Set against last week's 68.4% hold and 31.6% hike as of Aug 20, this is a complete reversal inside a single week. The line was last red from late June to mid-July. It also closes the gap flagged in last week's note: tightening had been coming from term premium, which this indicator cannot see, and it now sits squarely on the policy path where the definition can capture it.

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚 红 / 偶发惩罚 黄 / 奖励 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment red / episodic yellow / rewarded green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯。上期把 Nvidia 8/26 财报定为「下一个真实读点，若上调资本相关承诺仍遭抛售，本指标将最先转红」——结果是明确的奖励侧：营收 $962 亿、下季指引 $1080 亿、罕见给出 FY28 营收 +70% 展望，CFO 同时把前五大 hyperscaler 的 capex 路径指向 2027 年 $1.3 万亿，股价 8/27 涨 8.7%，全周纳指 +0.85%。市场对「更大的 capex」本身给了正回报。但对侧同样有实据、且是新的一条：Broadcom 因约 $3700 亿 AI 债务敞口的疑问单日 -6%，Nebius -10%、CoreWeave -9%。反应函数因此仍是分裂的，而且分裂线已经从「能否变现」移到「谁承担融资」——现金流上的支出被奖励（Alphabet、Amazon、Nvidia），债务驱动的敞口被惩罚（Broadcom、neocloud）。既非系统性惩罚（红）也非普遍奖励（绿），维持黄。下一个真实读点是 10 月下旬的 Q3 指引。
indicators.note_en: Yellow holds. Last week set Nvidia's Aug 26 print as the next real test, with the note that a sell-off on raised capital commitments would make this the first line to turn red. The verdict came in firmly on the reward side: $96.2bn of revenue, $108bn of next-quarter guidance, a rare fiscal 2028 outlook of about 70% growth, and a finance chief pointing top-five hyperscaler capex toward $1.3trn in 2027 — followed by an 8.7% gain on Aug 27 and a 0.85% weekly rise for the Nasdaq. Bigger capex, by itself, was paid for. The other side has fresh evidence too: Broadcom fell 6% in a session on questions about roughly $370bn of AI debt exposure, while Nebius dropped 10% and CoreWeave 9%. The reaction function stays split, and the fault line has moved from whether spending monetises to who carries the financing — spending out of cash flow is rewarded, as with Alphabet, Amazon and Nvidia, while debt-funded exposure is punished, as with Broadcom and the neoclouds. Neither systematic punishment nor blanket reward, so yellow. Next real read: Q3 guidance from late October.

indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热 红 / 部分对冲 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Broad admission red / partial hedging yellow / none green
indicators.note: 对冲表态继续累积但仍未成一致，维持黄灯。承认侧本期最重的一句来自 Pichai——「若 AI 泡沫破裂，没有人能全身而退」，比他此前「既理性、又有非理性成分」的双面表述明确了一档；Altman 则重申「聪明人为一个真实的内核过度兴奋」，直言仅三人团队的初创估值「疯狂」、投资者整体对 AI 过度兴奋，同时另一处承认「我们还没有迎来 iPhone 时刻」——这是他第一次把时间表本身也纳入对冲。反向侧仍由黄仁勋独扛，且本期底气更足：财报大超预期后重申不惧泡沫、称需求「已经指数化」、agentic AI 已经到来。关键判据不变、且本期更极端：无一家在承认过热的同时收缩支出——Nvidia 反而把 2027 年的 hyperscaler capex 路径抬到 $1.3 万亿。言行分离维持黄灯而非红灯；这一格转红需要的是某家把嘴上的谨慎兑现成指引上的收缩。
indicators.note_en: Hedging keeps accumulating without becoming unanimous, so yellow holds. The heaviest line on the admission side came from Sundar Pichai — if an AI bubble pops, nobody gets out clean — a step firmer than his earlier formulation about the moment being both rational and partly irrational. Sam Altman repeated that smart people get overexcited about a kernel of truth, called valuations on three-person startups insane and said investors as a whole are overexcited, while separately conceding the boom has not yet had its iPhone moment, which is the first time he has hedged on timing itself. Jensen Huang still holds the other side alone and with more conviction after the print, repeating that he is not afraid of a bubble and describing demand as having gone parabolic with agentic AI now arrived. The decisive test is unchanged and this week more extreme than ever: not one company is pairing an admission of overheating with reduced spending — Nvidia instead lifted the 2027 hyperscaler capex path to $1.3trn. Words and actions remain apart, which is yellow rather than red. Turning this line red requires someone to convert verbal caution into guidance.
